nota_fichero: El Libro de Pruebas en esta lengua. Se SUPERPONE sobre `assets/ledger.jsonl`, que es el registro firmado y viene en castellano: si aqui falta una entrada, ahi se ve la de origen. Los HECHOS --modelo, sha256, tok/s, hardware, firma-- no se traducen jamas: un nombre de modelo traducido deja de nombrar nada.
cabecera: Measured on the sovereign node on 2026-09-13. Each row carries the sha256 of the model file and the Ed25519 signature of whoever measured it. `ttft_ms` is NO_DATA because it was not measured: filling it with a plausible number would be the opposite of what this table does.

usos.qwen2.5-coder:3b: Lab turn 1: extracts the facts from a correction and returns clean JSON. The fastest of the six.
usos.deepseek-r1:7b: Turn 2: analyses why an answer failed and whether the failure is a pattern. Its card declares `thinking` and it still returns the whole schema with `think:false`.
usos.granite3-dense:8b: Turn 3, the door: compliance and injection checker. IBM trained it for this.
usos.qwen2.5:14b: Turn 4: the final judgement of the two-layer ensemble.
usos.swift-qwen:27b: Backup for turn 4. 27.3B DENSE: does the same work as the 30B in ten times the clock.
usos.qwen3-coder:30b: The judge’s Critic. MoE A3B: weighs 30B and activates ~3B, which is why a 30B runs faster than a 7B on an iGPU.
